mintAuthority.summary: BorrowerOperations issues USDFC against FIL Troves, but a live 2-of-3 Safe controls token ownership and the ProxyAdmin that can replace mint logic.

controls.label: USDFC BorrowerOperations
controls.evidence: Pinned token borrowerOperationsAddress() returns this protocol contract. Official DebtToken source restricts mint() to BorrowerOperations; ordinary minting is governed by FIL Trove rules, not an immutable end-to-end issuance constraint.

controls.label: USDFC owner and ProxyAdmin-owner Safe
controls.evidence: At Filecoin block 6422489, token owner and ProxyAdmin owner are this Safe. getThreshold()=2, getOwners() returns three addresses, paginated modules are empty and guard storage is zero. Signer independence and an enforced upgrade delay are not established.

review.evidence: At Filecoin block 6425379 on 2026-10-03, the token EIP-1967 implementation remains 0x584c1fa4ab299ae8f7154fce5b1bea7bddacfd0b; token owner() and ProxyAdmin owner() both return the same recorded 2-of-3 Safe, whose threshold and three owners were re-read at that pin. Sourcify match 11586794 verifies the deployed implementation's executable runtime against DebtToken.sol compiled with solc 0.7.6, optimizer 100; runtimeMatch is match, not an exact metadata match. Its mint() invokes _requireCallerIsBorrowerOperations(), which requires msg.sender == borrowerOperationsAddress. This resolves the earlier source-to-executable correspondence question without claiming identical compiler metadata. Published September 2026 upgrades demonstrate exercised Safe authority; code audits do not establish signer independence or financial reserve reconciliation. Wave 3 recovered the official September 7–18 incident thread: the September 8 update identifies an order-book accounting flaw allowing unfilled orders to create invalid balances; September 11 reports Quantstamp reproduction and a verified fix, and September 18 says lending markets and TokenVaults remain paused pending validation. These establish affected lending infrastructure and ongoing remediation, not an exhaustive abnormal-issuance or affected-contract review for core USDFC BorrowerOperations and its owner/ProxyAdmin-owner Safe. No core incident-free state is inferred. Financial reserve reconciliation is not applicable to native FIL collateral.
